name: spl_fear_scream
source: LATTICE + Brian's glitch-ghoul frame sheet (04e71111.png) at native pixels (sheet was 4x upscaled), 1/2 downscale, requantised; head faces screen-right
title: Fear scream — Brian's glitch ghoul glitches in beside the target and screams at it: neon streaks, sound-wave rings, the target is marked TERRIFIED; the head darkens and fades
qaNote: ghoul glitches in up-left of the target, screams: pink/violet sound rings travel to the target, TERRIFIED !! + aura land at hits[0]; head darkens to dim blue (his sheet) and dithers out
suggestedUse: Brian's glitch-ghoul curses (one facing: art faces screen-right; mirror the clip horizontally at runtime for a left-facing cast, anchor x -> cell w - x). Anchor = target tile ground point. spl_death_soul on a unit's death tile after its death/wreck anim. spl_fear_scream on the target (hits[0] = scream lands) -> spl_terrified_loop on the target while the debuff lasts (pairsWith). spl_banish on the target: move the unit down emitters.unitSink.px over startFrame..endFrame (clip/fade it at the tile), hide it at emitters.unitHideFrame. spl_haunt_intro (endsOn) -> spl_haunt_loop over a cursed unit. spl_curse_petrify (hits[0] = spikes land) -> spl_petrified_loop + grey tint config.unitTintHint on the unit sprite.
layering: Anchor = ground point of the TARGET tile (bottom vertex of its 64x32 diamond); draw over the target unit. The head art faces screen-right only: for a cast toward screen-left, mirror the clip horizontally at runtime (anchor x -> cell width - x).
pairsWith: spl_terrified_loop (status loop on the target from hits[0])
